drhp.business: SEDEMAC designs, develops and manufactures in-house control-intensive ECUs - including sensorless integrated starter generator (ISG), electronic fuel injection (EFI), combined ISG+EFI ECUs and EV motor control units for two/three-wheelers, and genset controllers and genset EFI ECUs for the industrial market. Critical, control-intensive products contributed 86.53% of revenue for the nine months ended December 31, 2025. The company originated from an IIT Bombay lab in 2007 and sells directly to OEMs, integrating proprietary technology into their platforms.

business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Indian Tier-I supplier selling directly to OEMs; proprietary control technologies conceived and developed entirely in-house with full control across design, engineering and manufacturing at two Pune facilities (MF1, MF2). Company earns export incentives and grants (Duty Drawback, RoDTEP, Maharashtra Electronics Policy 2016, M-SIPS) totalling 0.35%-1.18% of revenue.

concerns_observed: Extreme single-customer concentration: TVS Motor contributed 75.48%-83.46% of revenue and the top-3 customers 87.76%-91.22% across periods, with no long-term contracts.

Single-segment and single-product dependence: the mobility segment is ~85% of revenue and ISG/EFI/ISG+EFI ECUs are ~98%-99% of mobility control-intensive volume, exposing the company to a 2/3W electrification shift.
High import dependence: semiconductors and PCBs imported (from China, Taiwan and others) equalled 43%-54% of revenue, exposing margins to supply, tariff and FX shocks.
Pure Offer for Sale: the Company receives no proceeds; 20+ selling shareholders (largely PE/VC funds) are monetizing, and a 1,499:1 bonus was allotted just weeks before the filing.

Low promoter alignment: promoters hold only 22.26% pre-Offer, below the largest investor (A91 at 18.16%); promoter average cost (Rs 45.55-Rs 240.78, plus Nil-cost bonus) sits well below investor cost (Rs 352-Rs 386).

Production concentrated in two Pune facilities; sharp 9M FY26 receivables build (trade receivables rose to Rs 1,430 million from Rs 439 million), and a disputed Rs 305.67 million R&D-deduction tax matter remains open.
Governance/traceability flags: auditor emphasis-of-matter in FY24/FY25 reports, certain corporate records not traceable, and a historic RBI compounding penalty.

Post-listing related-party remuneration to promoters/KMP and board independence.
open_questions: What is the concrete plan and timeline to diversify away from TVS Motor, and what is the pipeline of new anchor customers by segment?
How will the company mitigate a 2/3W electrification shift given ISG/EFI ECUs are ~98%-99% of mobility volume, and what is the EV MCU revenue trajectory beyond volumes?
What is the exposure and mitigation for semiconductor/PCB imports (43%-54% of revenue) under rising US-China tariff risk?
What drove the large 9M FY26 trade receivables build (to Rs 1,430 million), and is it concentrated in TVS Motor?
What is the expected financial outcome of the open Section 35(2AB) R&D-deduction dispute (Rs 305.67 million disallowance) after ITAT restored the alternative-deduction claims?
Which corporate records are not traceable, and what were the auditor emphasis-of-matter items in FY24 and FY25?

parameter_scores.basis: 24.75% revenue CAGR FY23-FY25, EBITDA margin 12.82%->20.90%, PAT Rs 85.7M->Rs 715.0M (9M FY26).
TVS Motor 75%-83% of revenue; top-3 88%-91%; no long-term contracts.
Mobility ~85% of revenue; ISG/EFI/ISG+EFI ~98%-99% of mobility control-intensive volume.
~35% ISG ECU share, ~75-77% India genset controllers, in-house proprietary tech, >600 engineering man-years.
Imported semiconductors/PCBs 43%-54% of revenue; two-plant concentration in Pune.
Clean litigation but auditor emphasis-of-matter, untraceable records, RBI penalty; only 2 of 6 directors independent.
Pure OFS; promoters hold 22.26%; 1,499:1 pre-IPO bonus; promoter cost well below investor cost.

red_flags: Revenue concentration: a single customer (TVS Motor) is 75%-83% of revenue with no long-term contract.
Pure Offer for Sale with a 1,499:1 bonus allotted just weeks before the filing and 20+ selling shareholders (mostly PE/VC) exiting.
Statutory auditor emphasis-of-matter in the FY24 and FY25 audit reports and examination report.
Certain corporate records not traceable, with no assurance against future regulatory action.
Open income-tax dispute involving a Rs 305.67 million Section 35(2AB) R&D-deduction disallowance.
strengths_observed: Strong, accelerating growth and margins: revenue grew at 24.75% CAGR from Rs 4,230 million (FY23) to Rs 6,584 million (FY25) and reached Rs 7,707 million in 9M FY26; EBITDA margin expanded from 12.82% (FY23) to 19.00% (FY25) to 20.90% (9M FY26); PAT rose from Rs 85.7 million to Rs 470.5 million (FY25) and Rs 715.0 million (9M FY26).

Market leadership in defensible niches: ~35% domestic ISG ECU share (2W/3W), ~75%-77% India genset-controller share and ~14% global share, built on in-house proprietary control technologies (first-in-India SLC-based ISG; pioneered integrated eGov).
High capital efficiency and improving balance sheet: RoCE 17.51% (FY23) to 33.79% (FY25); Debt-Equity fell from 1.37 (FY24) to 0.17 (Dec 2025); net worth Rs 4,105 million (Dec 2025).

Deep technical moat: >600 man-years of IIT/NIT/BITS engineering contribution; >10 million control-intensive products cumulatively shipped; critical control-intensive products rose to 86.53% of revenue (9M FY26).

Diversifying growth vectors: EV motor control units grew from 9,364 (FY24) to 45,731 (9M FY26) and genset EFI ECUs from 13,768 (FY23) to 221,616 (9M FY26), with 68.85% of genset critical units exported.

Clean litigation profile: material litigation, criminal and regulatory actions against/by Company, Promoters and Directors are all Nil; contingent liabilities modest at Rs 28.26 million; no auditor change in three years.
